title: Demo Bay
text: Demo Bay is a fictional coastal town created exclusively to test text preparation. The promenade connects the railway station and the historical harbour. Travellers can walk from the city centre to a small museum, then continue to a public garden. The city guide recommends comfortable walking shoes and a reusable water bottle.

title: Example Mountain
text: Example Mountain is a fictional destination designed for software tests. Visitors can walk from the main square to a viewpoint above the valley. A marked trail leads past a small visitor centre and several rest stops. The example advises bringing a jacket because the weather changes quickly in the mountains.
